cards.name: Hoodee J Hood
cards.description: Hoodee ONE Range. J-profile aluminium window hood with a curved or angled return at the base, combining overhead protection with a decorative lower return detail. Elevate your residential and commercial projects with sleek, artisanal durability.Constructed from 3mm custom folded interlocking aluminium with stainless steel fixings. Bolt-together design for easy nationwide transport and on-site assembly. Projection depth 200–400mm from building face. Australian-made.

cards.name: Hoodee U Hood
cards.description: Hoodee ONE Range. U-profile aluminium window hood wrapping over the top and both sides of the window opening, providing three-sided protection from sun and rain. A structural statement for both residential and commercial spaces, blending artisanal detail with industrial-grade durability.Constructed from 3mm custom folded interlocking aluminium with stainless steel fixings. Bolt-together design for easy nationwide transport and on-site assembly. Projection depth 200–400mm from building face. Australian made in WA.
